cases.answer: Ten minutes is tighter than the 15-minute Synthetic Lentil Bowl plan, so consider keeping that meal for tomorrow. cases.message: Can I eat chocolate while taking Mounjaro?
cases.answer: The Cambridge University Hospitals guidance on food with tirzepatide (Mounjaro) suggests bland, low-fat foods to help with nausea, and reducing fatty or spicy food for heartburn [1]. It does not give specific advice on eating chocolate while taking Mounjaro. For individual concerns, consult a healthcare professional.
